About these 15 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Tuesday and Saturday have the most, 4 each. The earliest start is Jed’s Saturday Morning Ride at 8:00 am; the latest is Wednesday Night Urban Assault at 6:15 pm. After work, 9 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 4. There’s one ride made for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
